content: ASIL Attribute for Safety Requirements Type: valid Description: It shall be possible to specify an ASIL attribute for safety requirements. The values of the attribute shall at least carry values for the possible ASILs as listed in ISO 26262 in an unambiguous manner. Rationale: The necessary measures for ensuring functional safety of a system depend on the applicable ASIL. The assignment of the ASIL to system elements is done via the safety requirements. Failure to respect the ASIL could lead to unsafe systems. Use Case: [UC_SAFEX_00001], [UC_SAFEX_00002], [UC_SAFEX_00008] Dependencies: [RS_SAFEX_00001] Supporting Material: see ISO 26262-3 [1]
